name: @epoch/object-storage
description: Epoch Object-Storage SPI (W046, ACR-005) — the byte/evidence/asset store seam: content-addressed bytes (SHA-256 digest keys, idempotent put-by-digest), typed neutral object metadata (kind, tenant scope, evidence linkage descriptors — never vendor fields), digest-verified retrieval, and the reference in-memory implementation. Object storage holds BYTES by reference/digest (ACR-005); semantic records stay in the authoritative stores — this seam NEVER stores semantics, only evidence/assets addressed by their content digest. Deterministic: zero wall-clock, zero randomness, deterministic listing order. The real object-store adapter binding (S3-compatible etc.) is future service-layer work behind the same ObjectStore port.
